# Subhasta — the Ledger's frozen list of National Gallery of Art objects.
#
# One NGA object id (`objectid` in the NGA open-data objects.csv) per line, in the order the
# records appear in data/nga_subset.json, which is also the order the Ledger shows them
# (grouped by artist, then by begin year). 771 paintings and sculptures by 115 artists.
#
# This file is the source of truth for data/nga_subset.json. The subset was curated by hand
# from 1,236 NGA paintings/sculptures with provenance text by these artists, as a "market
# activity" selection; the exact selection rule is not recoverable, so the list is frozen
# here and only ever changes by hand. tools/nga_subset.py rebuilds the JSON from this list
# and the two NGA CSVs (CC0, https://github.com/NationalGalleryOfArt/opendata).
#
# To add a work: run `python3 tools/nga_subset.py --propose 20` (or `--artist "Name"` to add
# an artist) to see scored candidates, put the id on its own line where it belongs in the
# order (next to the artist's other works, by year), then run `python3 tools/nga_subset.py`
# to preview the change and `python3 tools/nga_subset.py --write` to apply it.
# Blank lines and anything after a `#` are ignored.
